sourcePolicy: This Amy-only v1 bundle is a new public-safe allowlist. It preserves only compact SDR discovery boundaries, directional Insight solution domains, public-sector and procurement fact finding, live-search and BOM limits, safety rules, current Amy Intelligence tool behavior, truthful close and follow-up language, and executive evaluation behavior.
